sets.title: Invoice-totals method with docblock interference on the cloned symbol
sets.description: The same invoice-totalling computeTotals method in three service classes under the cm_docblock family. Carrier A has no docblock (pristine). Carrier B has a minimal /** */ docblock with a one-line summary. Carrier C has a full multi-line docblock with @param and @return tags. After comment stripping, all three produce identical token streams — this is a Type-1 clone designed to test comment-stripping detectors. A near-miss distractor shares invoice vocabulary and foreach shape but computes a different result (revenue/cost margin ratio).
sets.notes: CM-03 (docblock) applied to the cloned symbol. Carrier A pristine vs Carrier C full docblock is the discriminating pair — after comment stripping, token streams are identical. Text-based matchers will flag all three as duplicates; token-based with comment normalization should also detect all three; raw text-based without comment handling will find only A≈B.

params.summary: Compute the result for the given inputs.
Compute invoice totals including subtotal, tax, discount and shipping.
tags: @param array $lineItems List of line items with qty and unitPrice.
@param float $taxRate Tax rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.08 for 8%).
@param float $discountRate Discount rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.05 for 5%).
@return array{invoice details} Computed subtotal, discount, tax, shipping and grand total.
